instruction: A bulbous 1950s sci-fi ray gun stamped from litho-printed tin, with a fat barrel coil, a spark-window dome, and a wind-up key on its side. Faded red-and-yellow rocket graphics, riveted seams, and small scratches sell the vintage lithographed toy look.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Retro Ray Gun in a retro-tin-toy style. Faded red-and-yellow rocket graphics, riveted seams, and small scratches sell the vintage lithographed toy look.
